currentTransformation.title: Transform the real autonomous climb into a legible, cinematic, responsive expedition
currentTransformation.state: BUILDING COHESIVE CLIMB AND ENCOUNTER SLICE — QUALITY NOT EVALUATED
currentTransformation.promise: One coherent climb: monumental original 3D environments, grounded grip-to-landing motion, tactical visible decisions, understandable guardian danger and opt-in terrain-aware spatial sound, with a minimal in-game HUD.
currentTransformation.nextDecision: Same OPEN climb/guardian/outcome transformation: added source-gated in-world 3D terminal tableau (28 bounded instanced fragments, depth-tested ground/vertical halos), genuine result/intermission follow-camera crane and one muted-by-default ending tone. These are real scene modules wired into WebGL, not screenshots. The source-pinned 2026-11-01 capture run 41313250501 provided 60+ second desktop/phone ascent and danger jobs, but outcome jobs failed because timed samples missed a complete result/intermission/restart; artifacts exist but are not yet visually critiqued. Fix outcome capture observability, inspect full-motion desktop/phone baseline vs candidate, collect five independent blind judgments per pillar and intended-hardware tails. QUALITY NOT EVALUATED.
currentTransformation.rejectedMicroMilestones: A green CI run, an isolated pose fix, a prettier screenshot or an extra UI icon never counts as a Gauntlet win.
